text:
maria: plotting a small UX for 'degrade insights' — goal: explain why auto-fallback fired, let ops act (snooze/revert/suppress), and keep audit intact. thoughts?

devin: love it. suggest a compact banner on the route: [Degraded] + short cause. clicking expands a details flyout with timeline + actions.

jonah: action semantics are important. make revert a guarded flow: confirm dialog + required reason. also provide 'prevent future auto-fallbacks for X' (a temporary pin).

sara: please no raw traces in main UI. high-level root cause and signal breakdown only. if someone needs the trace, put it behind an "advanced" view (role gated).

lia: telemetry list idea: snapshot id, anonymized prompt preview, p50/p95 latency delta, error % change, token delta, estimated token cost change, sample request link.

maria: mock: banner shows cause like 'Triggered: error_rate(5m)'. details show small timeline, top signals, 3 sampled anonymized requests, and buttons: schedule-revert (default 5m), revert-now (requires confirmation), snooze X, pin-primary X.

devin: backing policy example (for UI rendering):
{ "id": "auto-fb-23", "triggers": [{"type":"error_rate","window":"5m","thresh":0.08},{"type":"latency","window":"2m","thresh_ms":1000}], "action": {"degrade_to":"quantized-small","min_duration":"10m","cooldown":"5m"} }

jonah: how do we avoid flip-flopping? show cooldown and next-eligible-revert timestamp. backend should require a stability window before auto-un-degrading. UI should show predicted impact if revert now.

sara: billing callout: show estimated cost delta when degraded vs primary. ops often get surprised by token changes. add a small cost badge.

lia: audit retention defaults: 30d; enterprise option: 365d. provide CSV export and an /audit API for forensic teams. Exports should redact PII by default.

ops-bot: policy auto-fallback triggered - policy auto-fb-23 - canary rollout 10% traffic - recorded by ops-bot.

maria: security question: are we comfortable showing anonymized prompt snippets in the UI? tag @security for approval.

jonah: pragmatic: store full samples encrypted; show only hashed or truncated snippet in UI; export requires approval.

sara: UX nit: default action should be 'schedule revert 5m' not immediate revert. accidental immediate flips are risky.

maria: agree. schedule revert default + show reason prompt. if scheduled revert fails, auto-page on-call and show last snapshot id. i'll update Figma and share link.

devin: also include an 'explain' button that lists top 3 contributing signals (weighted). good for quick triage.

maria: great. i'll iterate and post updated screens. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
